title: Features | Virtual Concierge & AI Phone System for Restaurants | Hostie
description: See how Hostie answers every call, text, and guest question in your restaurant’s voice so you can grow revenue and stay in control. Manage reservations, events, and guest communication with real-time visibility, insights, and support from restaurant operators.
headings: Connects with the systems you already trust
blocks: Every call answered in your voice with custom prompts for reservations, events, takeout, and guest questions.
Get conversation transcripts, see interactions in real time, jump in whenever you need, and stay connected from any device.
Replace your phone system and bring calls, texts, and emails into one place—connected to your integrations.
Own your guest data so you always know who's calling, track trends, and use insights to guide decisions.
Conversational AI that feels like a trusted teammate, with multilingual support so every guest feels welcome.
Capture takeout orders by phone or text so your team can stay focused on the guests in front of them.
Responsive Support from People Who Get Restaurants
Always-on support from experienced operators, with hands-on setup. A true partner, not just a platform.
Protect your guest and business data with built-in security, compliance, and permissions to control access.
See aggregated data, manage conversations in one inbox, and use Hostie Scoring to keep your group running smoothly.
With Hostie, every guest interaction becomes an opportunity. We help you capture more revenue, give your team time back, and keep you in control, all with support from people who know restaurants.
Every call answered, every opportunity captured, so you never lose a reservation, order, or connection.
Every conversation is a chance to make a great first impression, welcome someone new, and turn them into a regular.
Hostie complements your team so they can focus on guests in the room, not the ringing phone.
See who’s calling, follow conversations in real time, and keep guest history with you.

Hostie brings calls, texts, reservations, private dining, takeout, and guest questions together in one place. Whether one guest reaches out or twenty do at once, every conversation gets an answer, so your team can stay focused on delivering great hospitality.
Native takeout ordering and two-way texting help you capture more orders, respond faster, and keep every guest conversation organized in one shared inbox.
Connects with the systems you already trust

Hostie connects seamlessly with your POS, reservations, and ordering platforms so every call, text, or guest question is answered. No missed reservations, no extra steps for your staff, and full visibility into every interaction. Hostie keeps everything connected so your team can focus on the service.
Hostie answers an average of 85% of questions with 15% seamlessly forwarded to a host.
Over millions of guest calls successfully managed in the last year.
Hostie brings over a decade of restaurant expertise.
